Scientific Hypothesis: Introduction pathways interact with minimum residence time (mrt) in affecting the success of non-native plant species in Catalonia. Specifically, species introduced unintentionally may exhibit a stronger positive relationship between mrt and invasion success (number of invaded plots) compared to species introduced through gardening or agri-forestry pathways. This relationship is supported by the observed correlation values, with "Unintentional" showing the highest correlation (0.438), followed by "Gardening" (0.218), and "AgriForest" (0.081). However, these correlations are not statistically significant due to the limited sample size and the absence of formal statistical testing in this analysis.
